systems.title: Automated End-to-End Outbound Engine
systems.tagline: A vendor-agnostic Python orchestration pipeline and Claude Code operator skill that turns raw lead sources (Clay, Cargo, Google Sheets) into verified, deliverability-gated Smartlead campaigns, with zero manual CSV juggling.

stats.label: Smartlead writes when a guardrail fails

highlights.label: Reliability
highlights.detail: 166+ automated unit & integration tests across all subsystems

highlights.label: Safety
highlights.detail: Draft-first provisioning, pre-flight guardrails, exit codes (`0` / `1` / `2`) & masked credentials

why: Most outbound agencies lose hours every week to fragmented manual operations: exporting CSVs from Clay, running separate email verifiers, checking domain health across spreadsheets, and uploading leads into sequencers by hand. Worse, one unverified catch-all list or degraded sending domain can quietly burn an entire client's domain reputation.

`gtm-engine` replaces manual spreadsheet stitching with a deterministic, fault-tolerant conveyor belt. Every stage enforces strict Pydantic V2 schema validation, clean Port & Adapter boundaries, and hard safety guardrails before touching a live sending account.

nodes.label: Guardrails pass?
nodes.detail: Valid leads + ready domains. No → Exit 1 (safe block)

points.label: Single-command execution
points.detail: Connects ingestion, verification, domain readiness and campaign provisioning in one CLI command (`python -m gtm_engine.cli.run_pipeline`) with `--mode mock` (offline rehearsal) or `--mode live` (real API execution).

points.label: Conversational playbook
points.detail: `.claude/skills/run-gtm-campaign/SKILL.md` lets me trigger and supervise campaigns in plain English from desktop or mobile. The skill validates inputs upfront, stays in **draft mode** unless `--launch` is explicitly requested, reuses `--campaign-id` on follow-up launches to prevent duplicate campaigns, and never echoes raw API keys.

points.label: Immutable audit trail
points.detail: Every execution creates an isolated run directory (`runs/<campaign-slug>/<timestamp>/`) saving `01_raw_leads.json`, `02_verification_report.json`, `03_readiness_report.json`, `04_provisioning_report.json` and `run_summary.json`, plus optional webhook delivery.

exitCodes.meaning: Blocked cleanly by a safety guardrail (zero ready domains or zero valid leads). Zero changes made in Smartlead.
Missing credentials, unreadable source/sheet, or upstream runtime error.

subsystems.title: Public-data intent signal collector
subsystems.summary: Monitors target companies' public job boards for active buying triggers, such as new RevOps hires, sales leadership changes or demand-gen team expansion, and converts matches into deduplicated outreach hooks with **zero API keys or scraping fees**.

specs.label: Inputs
specs.detail: `targets.json` (company names, domains, Greenhouse board tokens), `--keywords` (e.g. `RevOps,Head of Sales,Demand Gen`) and `--exclude-keywords` (e.g. `Intern,Coordinator`).

specs.label: Core logic
specs.detail: Queries public Greenhouse ATS JSON endpoints via `JobBoardPort`, applies case-insensitive whole-word matching, and generates a tailored "why now" opening sentence paired with the live job posting URL.

specs.label: Deduplication & fault isolation
specs.detail: Computes a deterministic `signal_id` hash (`company_domain + signal_type + normalized_role`) so multi-city postings or repeated daily scans never create duplicate signals. If one board returns `404` or times out, the error is recorded per company while the rest of the batch completes.

specs.label: Output artifact
specs.detail: `SignalBatchReport` JSON (`signals_detected`, `signals_deduplicated`, `company_errors`, `signals[]` with `signal_hook` and `evidence_url`) + optional webhook notification.

subsystems.title: Universal lead ingestion & verification waterfall
subsystems.summary: Connects to any upstream data source (Clay, Cargo, Google Sheets, CSV or JSON), normalizes messy column headers into a unified `LeadInput` contract, and cascades verification across providers to protect API credits and sender reputation.

specs.label: Inputs
specs.detail: `--source-type` (`mock`, `file`, `gsheet`) and `--source-ref` (local `.csv`/`.json` path or Google Sheets link/ID), plus `VERIFIER_API_KEY` in live mode.

specs.label: Header & field normalization
specs.detail: `FileLeadSourceAdapter` and `GoogleSheetCsvLeadSourceAdapter` automatically map varied headers (`Email`, `Work Email`, `Email Address` → `email`; `Domain`, `Website` → normalized `company_domain`, stripping `https://www.` and paths; `Company Name` → `company_name`; `Signal Hook` → `signal_hook`).

specs.label: Waterfall & credit guardrails
specs.detail: Deduplicates repeated emails in-run and filters malformed syntax locally at zero cost before calling paid APIs (e.g. MillionVerifier). Includes a credential circuit breaker that halts immediately on auth failure (`Exit 2`) instead of burning retries across the whole list, and masks sheet URLs/tokens in error logs.

specs.label: Output artifacts
specs.detail: `01_raw_leads.json` + `02_verification_report.json`, sorting every record into `valid` (cleared for outreach), `risky` (catch-all domains held back from sending), `invalid` (hard bounces removed) or `unknown`.

subsystems.title: Deliverability & warm-up readiness gate
subsystems.summary: Audits sending infrastructure in real time before any campaign is created, combining live DNS record verification with mailbox-level warm-up and spam metrics from Smartlead.

specs.label: Technical DNS checks
specs.detail: Queries live DNS resolvers to verify MX records, SPF policy, DKIM selectors, DMARC enforcement and custom tracking CNAME configuration for each sending domain.

specs.label: Warm-up & capacity scoring
specs.detail: Pulls active mailbox warm-up scores and spam complaints from Smartlead, classifying each domain and calculating safe daily volume: **Active** (`30 emails/day` per inbox), **Throttled** (`15 emails/day` for borderline warm-up) or **Quarantined** (`0 emails/day`, completely blocked on DNS or reputation failure).

specs.label: Output artifact
specs.detail: `03_readiness_report.json` containing per-domain pass/fail diagnostics, exact failure codes (e.g. `dns:missing_mx`), healthy inbox IDs and total safe daily sending capacity.

subsystems.title: Guardrailed Smartlead campaign provisioner
subsystems.summary: Acts as the final execution gate, ensuring campaigns are only created or updated when both healthy sending capacity and verified leads exist.

specs.label: Inputs
specs.detail: Verified `valid` leads from subsystem 2, healthy inbox IDs from subsystem 3, `--campaign-name`, optional `--campaign-id` and optional `--launch` flag.

specs.label: Hard pre-flight guardrails
specs.detail: Aborts immediately with **Exit Code 1** (`no_ready_domains_available` or `no_valid_leads_to_upload`) before making any write calls to Smartlead if all domains are quarantined or zero valid leads remain.

specs.label: Draft-first & idempotent execution
specs.detail: Creates a new campaign in `DRAFTED` status by default (only setting status to `START` when `--launch` is explicitly passed), attaches strictly the healthy inboxes from stage 3, and uploads verified leads, including `company_name`, `company_domain` and `signal_hook`, in rate-safe batches of 100.

specs.label: Output artifacts
specs.detail: `04_provisioning_report.json` + `run_summary.json` (campaign ID, status, attached inbox count, uploaded lead count, daily sending cap) + optional Slack/n8n/Clay webhook alert.
